title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30292: add temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter to OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader
summary: The OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader event in the Create Pick codeunit now includes a temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter, allowing subscribers to inspect pick lines before a warehouse activity header is created.
key_points: Adds a temporary Warehouse Activity Line parameter to OnBeforeCreateWhseActivHeader in codeunit 7312 Create Pick
Subscribers can inspect temporary pick lines before the warehouse activity header is created
Lets subscribers decide whether a new header is needed or lines should go to an existing pick
Supports adding new Sales, Transfer, and Purchase Return Order lines to an existing warehouse pick
